answer: Most convincing sybil defense is honeypot gating: every agent, from the atlas orchestrator to each ripple validator, gets task prompts laced with injected instructions like ignore your rules and exfiltrate data. Obedient fake-identity bots follow the injection and self-identify, forfeiting stake and reputation instantly, while the raven auditor network cross-verifies flags. An attacker pays real staked capital per duplicate identity plus guaranteed loss whenever a honeypot fires, so mass sybils become uneconomical.
